title: Law of the degree-bounded Fourier estimator
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a target function. The law of the degree-$k$ Fourier estimator program is the law obtained by drawing, independently and uniformly, one batch of labeled examples for each subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with $|S|\le k$, then returning the hypothesis whose coefficient at $S$ is the empirical Fourier coefficient rounded to granularity $2^{1-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: target Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
